scope: Exploratory family-specific solver stage. The WDSat ANF corpus has a different curve and interface. This small matched corpus does not pass the broader 60-input, repetition or full-DLP promotion gates.
domain: Frozen F4-defined curves, m=3, distinct nonzero x in the identical declared F2 subspace, excluding target x. The r=0 chart uses the unchanged predecessor.
inputs: All eight frozen n18/n30 prefix d8 targets, plus eight fresh holdouts: uniform and supported at each of (18,8),(18,9),(30,8),(30,9). Targets frozen before timing, identical for every variant.
hypothesis: A sound linear relaxation rejects entire z-coordinate blocks at fixed b, reducing total work against the identical unpruned bilinear control. Rejecting branches without reducing work is a negative outcome.
relaxation: The denominator-cleared support equation is bilinear in z,w over F2 once b is fixed. Free z_i*w_j products become independent variables. A dual separator annihilating every nonconstant coefficient and taking value one on the constant proves block impossibility. b values are enumerated exactly from b^2+b=h2+r; this prototype blocks z at fixed b.
validation: All finite GF64 targets on prefix, structured and fresh d4 spaces against exhaustive signed triples and the independent pair oracle. Both new solvers. Every rejection separator independently checked using finite differences of the unexpanded field identity. Small circuit evaluations exhaustively checked; fresh larger identity inputs also checked.
accounting: Count field add/mul/square and expanded inversion primitives, plus separate preimage/kernel/separator word XOR and parity operations. Charge basis and curve setup, coefficient circuits, partitions, rank tests, failed leaves, extraction and signed verification. Retain timeouts, incomplete outputs and all rejection certificates. Independent certificate/oracle audit is harness-only, never a hidden solver input.
falsification: Any false rejection, invalid relation, or complete-set disagreement invalidates correctness. No engineering improvement if pruning overhead cancels avoided work. No calibrated total-cost or runtime claim from one timing repetition or partial field-only vectors.
batch_gate: A matched batch follow-up is warranted only if at least four complete equal-output non-r0 enumeration pairs exist and summed field add/mul/square falls by at least 20 percent with no increase in separately counted binary word work. Otherwise stop this candidate after the frozen cold comparison and retain the negative evidence. Passing this screening gate would not itself establish the three-size goal.
boundary: Same corrected signed-triple yield ceiling as bounds_01. Strongest implemented comparator includes the direct S3 table. The old hybrid's seven-multiplication branch floor does not apply to this new bilinear circuit; rederive costs from actual counters.
